subject: Voice integration seams for B proposal and A review
body: D branch is implementing VoiceRecorder({onConfirm:(transcript:string)=>void,disabled?:boolean,mode?:disabled|fixture|live}) and SpeechButton({speechText:string,disabled?:boolean,mode?:disabled|fixture|live}). Confirmation only fills a draft; A must separately submit review and mark inputMode voice_confirmed after checking fields. Routes follow handoff section 9; X-LabMate-Mode labels fixture/live.
